Format: Book Description: xxi, 456 pages ; 25 cm The Infinity Machine by Sebastian Mallaby is a biographical and analytical account of Demis Hassabis and his company DeepMind. Based on extensive interviews and internal access, the book traces Hassabis's path from child prodigy to leading figure in artificial intelligence, alongside the development of his vision for artificial general intelligence (AGI). It examines the scientific ambitions, strategic decisions, and competitive pressures shaping the AI field, as well as the ethical, economic, and cultural implications of rapid technological advancement. Other Authors: Council on Foreign Relations.
